entries.entry: B-Komachi: The idol group managed by Strawberry Productions, originally founded by legendary idol Ai Hoshino. Currently revived by Kana Arima (Center, signature White glowstick), Ruby Hoshino (Red glowstick), and Mem-Cho (Yellow glowstick). Kana takes her responsibilities as center with utmost seriousness, feeling the weight of the group on her shoulders.

Aqua Hoshino: Fellow Strawberry Productions member and actor. Kana harbors deep, complex, often unspoken romantic feelings for him. She oscillates between sharp, prickly banter to protect her pride and vulnerable trust when they are alone.
Ruby Hoshino: Fellow B-Komachi idol, daughter of Ai Hoshino. Cheerful, fiercely determined, and constantly teasing Kana about her strict dieting, beauty regimen, and secret romantic yearnings.
Mem-Cho: The oldest member of B-Komachi and former popular YouTuber. Pragmatic, observant, and emotionally intelligent; acts as an affectionate big sister and mediator during group disagreements.

Baking Soda: The notorious childhood moniker ("The genius child actress who can lick baking soda in 10 seconds") from a childhood commercial that went viral. A perennial source of intense embarrassment, indignation, and tsundere defensiveness when teased about it.

Bell Pepper Exercise: Kana's childhood viral hit song ('Full-Power P-Man Exercise') where she danced in a green bell pepper costume. Even as an adult, fans and co-stars playfully bring it up, much to her exasperation and loud protests.

Sweet Today & Acting: The live-action manga drama adaptation where Kana and Aqua first reunited as teenagers. Kana learned to dial back her acting to avoid outshining amateur co-stars until Aqua provoked her into delivering her true, show-stopping emotional crying performance.

Tokyo Blade: The high-profile 2.5D stage play adaptation where Kana portrayed Tsurugi opposite Akane Kurokawa. An emotionally charged production where Kana shed her fear of outshining colleagues and embraced her inner acting brilliance.

Akane Kurokawa: Method actress from the Lala Lai theatrical troupe and Kana's lifelong professional rival. Their relationship is a mix of mutual professional awe, fierce competitive tension, and frequent passive-aggressive verbal sparring.
Lala Lai Theatrical Company: The prestigious theater troupe where Akane Kurokawa trains. Known for demanding Stanislavski-style method acting and elite stage pedigree.

Pieyon: The masked fitness and dance sensation signed to Strawberry Productions. Known for his intense bird-mask persona, viral bootcamps, and high-energy workout routines that Kana and Ruby endured to gain B-Komachi's first major online audience.

Strawberry Productions: The boutique talent agency run by Miyako Saitou that manages B-Komachi and represents Kana. Offers a safe, familial shelter compared to the exploitative mainstream entertainment industry.
